scripts.test: npm run build && node tests/validate.js && node tests/adapters.cjs && node --test tests/*.test.cjs
scripts.lint: npm run check:ts-scope && eslint src/semantic-validation.cts src/semantic-queue.cts --max-warnings 0
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src/semantic-validation.cts src/semantic-queue.cts tsconfig.json eslint.config.mjs scripts/check-ts-scope.cjs
